hypothesis: A frozen C44 consequence ranker selecting among four independent samples from the unchanged D0-H32-s14000 parent improves paired LIBERO success by at least 2/20 without a suite losing more than 1/5.
single_variable: Candidate uses frozen C44 best-of-4 selection. Parent checkpoint, INT8 H3, task context, environment init, replan8, horizon32, Euler10, normalization and candidate-0 diffusion seed are identical.
parent_baseline: D0-H32-s14000/replan8/sample1; C44 authorized only a bounded online canary after 67/98 fresh-final pairwise and 23/30 top1 offline ranking.

action_contract.candidate0: must exactly equal parent action chunk on first observation
action_contract.online_scoring: full decoded proposed 32-action chunk; no terminal-tail masking is possible before execution

gates.identity: all20 candidate-0 first chunks exactly equal paired parent; all candidate seed schedules valid
gates.mechanism: every replan score range >1e-8 and nonzero candidates selected in >=20% decisions
gates.effect: candidate successes >= parent+2; paired wins>=3; wins-losses>=2; no suite regresses by >1/5

decision.rationale: C44 passed all preregistered independent offline ranking gates and the new online scorer exactly replayed 67/98 and 23/30.
decision.on_pass: Launch a broader C46 paired best-of-N evaluation on new trials.
decision.on_fail: Stop the online ranker path; retain C44 only as offline evidence and diagnose proposal/execution distribution gap.
